title: The Plague Cart
text: At dawn a cart rolls in with no driver and no horse, creaking through the open gate on its own. Its shrouded cargo hums with flies, and something under the cloth is moving. The physicians want it; the priests want it burned.

options.label: Burn it, cart and all, before whatever moves under the cloth gets out.

outcomes.text: The smoke is black and smells of honey. For a week the city's bees swarm toward the ashes.

options.label: Quarantine it outside the walls under the guards' watch.

outcomes.text: It rots in a field, watched by nervous guards. Nothing grows there after.
Something crawls from it in the night and is never found. Sometimes, in the lower town, a door is found open in the morning.

options.label: Let the physicians study what moves under the cloth, whatever it costs them.

outcomes.text: The physicians learn much, and the Apothecary's shelves fill with new tinctures. Some of them move.
The physicians learn much. Two of them die of it, smiling, and the fever spreads to a House.
